vertical_certificate.scope: Linear anelastic hydrostatic rigid-lid vertical column; positive supplied N²/density, no moist convection or compressible/terrain evolution

box_coupling_audit.explanation: Donor transport of a discontinuous two-box background adjusts only receiving air. Its projected infinitesimal response is direction-dependent; do not directly couple it to a smooth first mode with an independently imposed c²divU adjustment.

limits: One dry linear anelastic mode; fixed reference and reflecting walls, no moisture/phase/radiation/terrain feedback. Old moist two-box state not connected.
